case.summary: Case CASE-019 (Card SC-03019-K957): The real-time risk model flagged transaction 4012227 ($412.46, billing mismatch) with a score of 0.89 [EV-545cb4ec]. The card SC-03019-K957 showed three prior transactions averaging $74.35 [EV-5177e48d] and three online transactions within 48 hours of the flagged transaction [EV-2195055c]. The transaction originated from a new device (Samsung SM-G973F) and an anonymous proxy connection in Argentina [EV-5b21c6fa, EV-ca61c122]. The same device profile appears in a prior confirmed fraud case [EV-abb90528], and the customer SC-03019 has a previous fraud case CC-4328 [EV-7f79d48e]. A pattern-and-keyword retrieval also returned a prior account_takeover case [EV-c4fc536e]. The customer reported they did not make the purchases and still possess the card [EV-08775a39].

sar.narrative: Suspicious Activity Report for CASE-019 involving account takeover pattern. Transaction 4012227 ($412.46) triggered a real-time risk score of 0.89 due to billing mismatch [EV-545cb4ec]. The associated card SC-03019-K957 exhibited anomalous velocity with three online transactions in 48 hours [EV-2195055c] and a historical average transaction amount of $74.35 [EV-5177e48d], indicating deviation from normal spend. The transaction was initiated from a previously unseen device (Samsung SM-G973F) [EV-5b21c6fa] via an anonymous proxy IP located in Argentina [EV-ca61c122], both hallmarks of account takeover. The device fingerprint has been linked to a prior confirmed fraud case [EV-abb90528], and the customer SC-03019 has a history of fraud (case CC-4328) [EV-7f79d48e]. Pattern-based retrieval corroborates the account_takeover classification [EV-c4fc536e]. The customer denies authorizing the transactions and confirms physical card possession [EV-08775a39]. Total exposure across three transactions (4012227, 4012229, 4012230) is $594.31. The evidence supports a finding of fraud consistent with account takeover.
